summary: Verified iteration_4 UX additions for failed/queued/completed run explanation and upload auto-fetch nudge. Backend contract for failed run 61f22fcc-... confirmed (status=failed, metrics=null, match_points=[], diagnostics populated with 1 entry, quality_gate.checks has 9 populated failing checks). Frontend: (1) Opening failed run from /runs navigates to workspace and shows data-testid=results-status-note with title 'No valid transform found' and body containing the diagnostics and lat/long guidance, run-outcome-title shows 'Registration rejected', metric-rmse-value shows 'N/A' (i.e. no value). (2) Opening completed run 78cd45c9-... shows NO results-status-note and metric-rmse-value=0.186. (3) Uploading a small PNG via source-image-input with no reference selected auto-populated reference-catalog-select (WAC mosaic), enabled run-registration-btn, and produced the exact nudge toast 'Auto-matched cached WAC Hapke 7-Band Mosaic · enter the frame lat/long for a closer regional match'. Note: metric tiles for a failed run render as 'N/A' rather than the em-dash '—' mentioned in the review request, because format(null,...) returns 'N/A'. Semantically identical (no numeric value); flagging as informational only.

critical_code_review_comments: ResultsPanel.tsx statusNote logic is inlined via nested ternaries — readable now (single file) but any future 4th status branch will get messy; extract to a helper returning {tone,title,body}.

Home.tsx handleFile silently calls autoReference() without awaiting; the toast can appear after the user has already interacted further. Fine for now, but be aware the source upload and the auto-reference fetch race.

The 'Registration rejected' banner and the new results-status-note both display run.diagnostics — duplicate content. Consider suppressing the diagnostics line in run-outcome-detail when results-status-note is shown, or vice versa.
